claim_boundary: Single-rater visual adjudication of the 24 masks recovered by the fallback ladder on the Phase 2c-B calibration split. The rater is the implementer, judging colour overlay renderings at 260x200 px. This is NOT ground truth: no pixel-accurate reference masks exist for these photographs, no second rater scored them, and no inter-rater agreement is available. It is recorded because it is the only evidence in this phase that speaks to mask CORRECTNESS rather than to geometric validity, and leaving it as an unwritten impression would have been worse than stating its limits.
interpretation: The ladder is reliable exactly where the product contract applies and unreliable outside it. On single-subject captures every recovered mask was usable. On multi-subject scenes 18 of 19 were an arbitrary block carved out of a pile - which passes every geometric guard, because a block cut from a heap of apples has the same geometry as one apple.
